item.description:
Say this Psalm 91 prayer before you sleep tonight. Let God's covenant of divine protection and supernatural peace surround your home, family, and mind from wall to wall.
Scripture: Psalm 91:1-16 (KJV / NKJV Public Domain text). Watch with kinetic display subtitles on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7RDX0fbIOtQ

item.title: Psalm 23: The Lord Is My Shepherd — Night Prayer for Rest, Healing & Peace
item.description:
Surrender the worries and fatigue of this day into the gentle hands of the Good Shepherd. He restores your soul and leads you beside still waters.
Scripture: Psalm 23:1-6. Watch full video on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@TheSecretPlace

item.title: Psalm 121: He Who Keeps You Will Neither Slumber Nor Sleep
item.description:

Scripture: Psalm 121:1-8. Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@TheSecretPlace
